description: Verify a Yazılım Koçu quote signature: pass the compact JWS (from sales_conversation quote_signature.jws or get_quote). Checks the Ed25519 signature against the published keys, the issuer and expiry, and whether that version is present in the append-only ledger. Read-only; the same check can be done independently with any JOSE library and /.well-known/jwks.json.

jws.description: Compact JWS (three base64url parts separated by dots).
